background: warm ivory #f3efe4, subtle amber #ecb617 circular spotlight
composition: entire product visible, centered, occupying 72–78% of square frame, safe margins for UI badges
lighting: soft studio lighting, realistic contact shadow, crisp premium ecommerce photography
invariants: Preserve product identity, packaging shape, original brand logo, exact label lettering, colors and quantity. Do not invent hidden sides, extra packaging, accessories or product claims.
avoid: No added text, prices, discount badges, watermarks, extra products or props. Do not bake UI labels into the image.
